title: introduce-session-poise-credential-shim-smooth-retry-presets-and-typed-stream-iterator-bump
author: Sana Patel
description: Motivation: Improve cross-sdk parity for streaming ergonomics while reducing token-refresh contention and offering a pragmatic retry profile for high-throughput clients. This PR introduces: 1) SessionPoise: a lightweight credential shim that centralizes small-window refreshes, fans-out refresh attempts to avoid thundering, and exposes an explicit lease API for advanced consumers. 2) Smooth retry preset: a new retry profile (smooth) tuned for streaming consumers with gentle initial backoff and capped jitter to reduce bursty retry storms. 3) TypedStreamIterator: an ergonomic async iterable/iterator wrapper with precise typing for TS consumers that maps one-to-one with Python/Go counterparts (see ENG-2142 parity spec). 4) Version bump to 0.10.0 and migration notes. Summary of changes: - core/auth/sessionPoise.ts: new shim (implements lease, prefetch, and backoff hints) - core/retries/presets.ts: added "smooth" profile and unit tests - stream/typed-iterator.ts: typed async iterator facade with cancellation signal and cursor checkpoint API - examples/streaming/streaming-typed-async.ts: updated example and migration guide - docs/migration/0.10.0.md: upgrade notes and cross-sdk parity table - test/*: added integration tests that assert token refresh fanout behavior and retry shaping Commits: "initial commit for session poise and typed iterator"; "add smooth retry preset and tests"; "docs: migration notes and examples"; "fix: race in sessionPoise prefetch logic after review"; "ci: adjust test timeouts for flaky envs". Changed areas (high level): ["src/auth/sessionPoise.ts","src/retries/presets.ts","src/stream/typed-iterator.ts","examples/streaming/*","docs/migration/0.10.0.md","package.json"] Review thread summary: Sana: "Initial implementation, primary goal is ergonomy and parity; performance numbers in PR description." Evan: "Nice direction; please tighten types and add a stress test that simulates 100 concurrent clients failing token refresh." Sana: "Added stress test and tightened types (commit 4). Also added opt-in telemetry hooks to observe lease churn." Marta: "SessionPoise looks good—one nit around promise cancellation semantics; please ensure cancellation doesn't leak KV cache handles." Sana: "Addressed cancellation and added unit test to assert no leak on aborted streams." Priya: "Approve after CI green; we should coordinate parallel bump in py/go SDKs (ENG-2210)." Approvals: Evan Brooks (approved), Marta Ruiz (approved), Priya Nair (approved). CI checks: build (pass), lint (pass), unit-tests (pass), integration-stress (pass after rerun), e2e-examples (pass). Merge: squash-and-merge on 2026-02-18. Merge commit note: "feat(ts): sessionPoise credential shim, smooth retry preset, typed stream iterator, bump v0.10.0" Release notes: "v0.10.0: Introduces SessionPoise credential shim to reduce refresh contention, adds 'smooth' retry preset optimized for streaming workloads, and exposes a TypedStreamIterator for better ergonomics and cross-SDK parity. See docs/migration/0.10.0.md for migration steps and compatibility notes with py/go SDKs." Migration guidance: "Clients using the older stream.helpers async iter must migrate to TypedStreamIterator or use the compatibility wrapper exported in stream/compat.ts. SessionPoise is opt-in via client config:{ credentialMode:'session-poise' } and safe to enable in most hosted/dedicated deployments. Coordinate SDK upgrades with backend teams; the server-side session lease heartbeat header version was bumped (x-rw-session-lease v2)." Post-merge follow-ups: "PR #872469 in redwood-sdk-python will publish the Python SessionPoise adapter and examples; redwood-sdk-go follow-up PR scheduled for ENG-2210." Notes on uniqueness: This PR focuses on a specific credit-shaping shim and a fresh retry profile aimed at streaming consumers and contains a types-first iterator surface targeting parity rather than the previously heavily refactored credential factories.
